```yaml
name: Copilot Agent Environment Setup
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.88.0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22.14.0
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@10.13.1

      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: latest

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: |
          curl -LsSf https://github.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall/releases/latest/download/cargo-binstall-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv cargo-binstall /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Install development tools with cargo-binstall
        run: |
          cargo binstall watchexec-cli -y
          cargo binstall cargo-insta -y
          cargo binstall typos-cli -y
          cargo binstall cargo-shear -y
          cargo binstall dprint -y

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Verify tool installations
        run: |
          echo "Rust version:"
          rustc --version
          echo "Node.js version:"
          node --version
          echo "pnpm version:"
          pnpm --version
          echo "just version:"
          just --version
          echo "cargo-binstall version:"
          cargo binstall --version
          echo "watchexec version:"
          watchexec --version
          echo "cargo-insta version:"
          cargo insta --version
          echo "typos version:"
          typos --version
          echo "cargo-shear version:"
          cargo shear --version
          echo "dprint version:"
          dprint --version

      - name: Run cargo check
        run: cargo check

      - name: Completion message
        run: |
          echo "✅ Copilot agent environment setup complete!"
          echo ""
          echo "Available commands:"
          echo "- just ready: Run all project checks"
          echo "- just fmt: Format code"
          echo "- just test: Run tests"
          echo "- just lint: Run linters"
          echo ""
          echo "All tools have been installed and verified."
```
